Fuzzer for fd_chkdup that compares regular and slow duplicate checks on split address lists.

# Purpose
This file is a libFuzzer entry point for testing `fd_chkdup`, which checks for duplicate account addresses. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) sets up the Firedancer runtime, disables log backtraces, and configures the log level so that warning logs stop execution. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) reads fuzz data as a small metadata header plus a sequence of `fd_acct_addr_t` records, then splits the record list into two parts and passes both parts to the duplicate-check logic.

The test creates an `fd_rng_t` instance and an `fd_chkdup_t` instance, then compares the result of `fd_chkdup_check` with `fd_chkdup_check_slow` for the same input. It also calls `fd_chkdup_check_fast`, but it does not compare that result because the fast path can report false positives. The file is therefore a fuzz test for the duplicate-check API, with a focus on matching the regular and slow implementations.
